transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… my appetite’s been off the last few weeks. I’ll get home after a shift, have food I normally like, and I just kind of stare at it. I can force a few bites down, but that’s about it.
Have you lost any weight over the past few weeks?
I haven’t really checked the scale. But yeah… with how little I’ve been eating lately, I wouldn’t be surprised if I’m down some.
Have you been feeling anxious or stressed about anything lately?
I don’t know… I mean, nothing specific comes to mind. Work’s work, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been especially anxious about something.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting differently lately?
Maybe a little looser, yeah. I haven’t really been paying close attention, but I’ve barely been eating the last few weeks, so… it would make sense.
Have you found yourself less interested in things you normally enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to like going for a run in the morning, messing around on guitar, cooking dinner… lately I just skip it. It all feels like work, and I can’t really make myself care.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… most days, I guess. It’s not like I’m crying all the time or anything. It’s more just this heavy, flat feeling. Even at home or at work, I’m there, but I don’t really feel there.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight, such as more than 5% of your body weight, over the past few weeks?

I’m not sure about a number… I haven’t weighed myself. But yeah, my appetite’s been pretty bad the last few weeks. Even stuff I’d usually want after a shift, I just kind of push it around and force a few bites.
Have you noticed any change in your weight that's caused concern for you or others?

Yeah… a little. I haven’t really checked my weight, but I came in because these last few weeks I’ve barely wanted to eat. Even stuff I usually like after work just kind of sits there, and I force down a few bites.
Have you had anyone comment on your weight loss recently?
Not really directly, no. I mean… I came in more because I’ve barely had an appetite the last few weeks. Food I usually like after a shift just kind of sits there, and I force a few bites.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight over the last month?
I don’t know if it’s that much. I haven’t really checked. I just know the last few weeks my appetite’s been pretty bad… I barely want to eat, even after work.
Have you been trying to lose weight?
No… I haven’t been trying to. I just haven’t had much appetite lately. Even food I usually like after work, I kind of just pick at it.
Have you been wanting to lose weight?
No… not really. I wasn’t wanting to lose weight. I just haven’t had much appetite these past few weeks, and even stuff I usually like after work, I’m kind of forcing down a few bites.
Did you want to lose weight when this started happening?
No… I didn’t want to lose weight. It just kind of happened because I haven’t had much appetite. Food’ll be there after a shift, even stuff I like, and I’m just… forcing a few bites.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I’m not afraid of gaining weight. It’s more that I just haven’t felt hungry lately. Stuff I usually eat after work just kind of sits there, and I only manage a few bites.
Has fear of gaining weight influenced your decision to restrict your food intake?
No. It wasn’t about fear of gaining weight. I just… haven’t had much appetite these last few weeks. Even food I usually like after work, I kind of just force down a few bites.
Have you been trying to lose weight on purpose?
No… not on purpose. I came in because I’ve barely had an appetite these last few weeks. Even stuff I usually like after a shift just kind of sits there, and I only force down a few bites.
Did you intentionally stop eating as much as you used to?
Not intentionally, no. I just… haven’t been hungry much the last few weeks. Even after work, food I usually like just sits there and I only get a few bites down.
Did you want your weight to go down when this all started?
No… I wasn’t trying for that. I just haven’t really had an appetite lately. Food I normally like after work, I just kind of pick at it.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained back the weight you've lost?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not really focused on the weight. It’s more that I just haven’t had much appetite, and I’m forcing down a few bites when I can.
Do you think your loss of appetite is related to your feelings of sadness?
I guess it could be. I’m not really sure… I just know these last few weeks I haven’t felt like eating much, even after work. Stuff I usually like just kind of sits there and I force a few bites.
